goal_checks.notes: renderPage/renderTextLayer accept a signal and cancel the pdfjs task on abort; usePageStage aborts on cleanup. PROVEN live: the canvas error stopped and the Konva stage (.konvajs-content, 2 layers) mounted. The stage had never mounted before, so 031's cursors and 010's highlight layer were dead in the browser.

The text layer is select-text unless a draw tool is armed. PROVEN live: with the class in place (no runtime hack), a selection of 60 characters produced a highlights row; before it, window.getSelection().toString() was empty because the stage's select-none was inherited.
use-page-stage.test.ts asserts the paint signal is aborted on unmount; page-stage.test.tsx asserts the text layer's select class follows `drawing`. Both pass; suite 363 passed / 14 skipped.

issues_found: The pdfjs render task was never cancelled, so the Konva stage never mounted in dev (and could break on any rapid page/zoom change). Fixed.
The page stage's select-none made the text layer unselectable, so task 010's text highlight was impossible in the browser. Fixed.
